material.description: OpenStax, College Physics, Chapter 7, §§7.3 “Gravitational Potential Energy” and 7.4 “Conservative Forces and Potential Energy”: §7.3 relates gravitational potential energy to an object's position in the object–Earth system; §7.4 defines potential energy for conservative forces and treats spring configuration. These sections support the Claim's position/configuration framing at an introductory level. They do not establish an exhaustive account of every potential-energy model or system.
